summary: Tested live backend and responsive storefront/cart flows. Core menu, auth registration/session, backend order validation and totals, customer admin denial, and inquiry persistence passed; catering with blank optional email and requested .local setup credentials failed validation.

critical.issue: Required test/admin email test-admin@navyug.local is rejected with 422 by EmailStr because .local is treated as reserved, so the supplied first-admin setup flow cannot create the requested account.

minor.issue: Optional email sent as an empty string returns 422 instead of accepting it as omitted/null; the frontend always submits the blank email field.

integration_issues.flow: Catering inquiry with email left blank
integration_issues.issue: Form displays backend validation error and does not persist inquiry.

action_items: Allow valid setup/test account emails configured with .local, or update the provided test credential domain contract.
Normalize blank optional inquiry email to null before Pydantic validation or omit the field in the frontend payload.
Add the missing customer profile/order-history UI and menu management controls to meet the requested complete app scope.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin dashboard exposes orders, catering, and contact only; it has no menu CRUD despite the requested admin menu management.
Frontend has no customer profile or order-history route, despite backend /api/orders existing.

success_rate.backend: 100% (5/5 regression tests; separate setup/blank-email probes failed)

seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST-prefixed customer/order and inquiry records through public APIs; no admin was created because the supplied .local admin email was rejected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run setup with supplied test-admin@navyug.local and the catering form with email blank after fixes; then validate admin status updates and admin menu CRUD. Core mobile home/cart behavior is passing.
rca of the issue: Catering serializes every form field with Object.fromEntries(FormData), producing email="". Backend declares Optional[EmailStr], which permits null/missing but not an empty string. Admin setup uses Pydantic EmailStr whose current validator rejects the reserved .local domain before setup-key/business logic runs.
